meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

howto.what: 用你从 cmem.ai → Connect 拿到的 sync token、user id、SyncHub URL,配置 claude-mem-cowork 插件的 config.json,让 hooks 能捕获和注入记忆;token 只经文件写入,不在对话里回显。
howto.when: 当你说要「设置 claude-mem」「连接 cmem」等,或直接贴出 cmem.ai Connect 的 sync token、user id、SyncHub URL 时触发。

howto.what_en: Uses your cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) to write the claude-mem-cowork plugin's config.json, so hooks can capture and inject memory. The token is only moved via file writes, never echoed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up or pair claude-mem, connect cmem, add a cmem key, or set up cloud sync in Cowork, or paste the cmem.ai Connect values.

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem; my sync token is cm_xxx
say_en.note: Writes the plugin config.json; token not echoed

say_en.text: Pull the three values from this Connect blurb and pair
say_en.note: Extracts token, user id, SyncHub URL
Runs hook status and reports masked output
